sentences.text: Nanantius eos is recognized as a member of the Enantiornithes, a diverse group of early birds that vanished during the mass extinction.
Fossil evidence suggests these creatures were seabirds, indicated by a leg bone discovered inside the stomach of a marine reptile.
This species was first formally described in 1986.
The defining specimen, known as the holotype, was unearthed at Warra Station near Boulia in Queensland.
It is tentatively grouped with a clade containing Vorona, Grabauornis, and Yungavolucris.
The fossil record indicates they existed between 106.3 and 100.5 million years ago.
Some researchers question its placement in the Enantiornithes because the leg bone traits are not considered diagnostic enough.
